title: v2 sessions have no release/do-based release path — leaked claims can only be waited out, not freed
description: Observed 2026-09-06/07 while running demix visual-QA (T-LU-598 in the demix repo): a v2 claim session (s-e380bd, then later s-0edec9) showed up in `simemu claims` with its claimant PID already dead (ALIVE=no) well before its expires_at TTL. There is no way to explicitly free it: `simemu release <session>` does not exist for v2 sessions -- the top-level 'release' subcommand only operates on the OLDER v1 acquire/release reservation API ('Release a reserved simulator'), and the v2 API's own subcommand list (claim, do, config, sessions, lease, claims, locks, status, ...) has no release/free/unclaim verb at all. The only way a leaked v2 claim goes away is for something else (a later 'claim' call's own reaper) to notice the dead PID and reap it -- which it does do (confirmed: a subsequent 'simemu claim ios' call printed '[simemu-session] Reaped session <id> -- claimant PID dead' and cleaned it up), but there is no ON-DEMAND way for the agent that KNOWS it is done with a session to say so. This is the same subsystem as T-054 (idle timeout reaps a still-in-use claim too early) and T-LU-054 here (reaping keyed to claimant PID rather than device-in-use) but the opposite failure direction: T-054/T-LU-054 are about reaping TOO EAGERLY; this is about having NO voluntary way to release AT ALL, so claims can only be freed by (a) waiting for the claimant process to die and a future claim call's reaper to notice, or (b) T-054/T-LU-054's PID-liveness heuristic misfiring. Today three lanes lost evidence to claim problems in this same subsystem -- worth fixing as one coherent piece of work with T-054/T-LU-054 rather than three separate patches to the same reaping logic.
acceptanceCriteria: simemu do <session> release (or an equivalent explicit v2 verb) exists and frees the claim immediately, independent of the idle-timeout/PID-liveness reaper
simemu claims / simemu status no longer shows the session after an explicit release, without needing another claim call to trigger reaping
Documented alongside T-054 and T-LU-054 as the same claim-lifecycle subsystem, cross-referenced from all three
proofRequirements: Repro: claim a session, kill the claiming process (or its child), issue an explicit release verb, then confirm 'simemu claims' no longer lists it without needing a second unrelated claim call to trigger the reaper
